name: Venti
title: Windborne Bard
description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

skills.name: Divine Marksmanship
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, favorable winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Skyward Sonnet
skills.description:
O wind upon which all hymns and songs fly, bear these earth-walkers up into the sky!

Press
Summons a Wind Domain at the opponent's location, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching opponents into the air.

Hold
Summons an even larger Wind Domain with Venti as the epicenter, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and launching affected opponents into the air.
After unleashing the Hold version of this ability, Venti rides the wind into the air.

Opponents hit by Skyward Sonnet will fall to the ground slowly.
skills.info: In the days when gods and men walked the earth together, the heavens were filled with countless songs. This melody has long since been forgotten.

skills.name: Wind's Grand Ode
skills.description:
Fires off an arrow made of countless coalesced winds, creating a huge Stormeye that sucks in opponents and deals continuous Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Stormeye comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.
skills.info: Many hymns written in praise of the Anemo Archon have been lost to time. This one sings of his mastery over the wind.

passives.name: Embrace of Winds
passives.description: Holding Skyward Sonnet creates an upcurrent that lasts for 20s.

passives.name: Stormeye
passives.description:
Regenerates 15 Energy for Venti after the effects of Wind's Grand Ode end.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, this also restores 15 Energy to all characters of that corresponding element in the party.

passives.name: Windrider
passives.description:
Decreases gliding Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

constellations.name: Splitting Gales
constellations.description: Fires 2 additional arrows per Aimed Shot, each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG.

constellations.name: Breeze of Reminiscence
constellations.description:
Skyward Sonnet decreases opponents' Anemo RES and Physical RES by 12% for 10s.
Opponents launched by Skyward Sonnet suffer an additional 12% Anemo RES and Physical RES decrease while airborne.

constellations.name: Ode to Thousand Winds
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Wind's Grand Ode by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Hurricane of Freedom
constellations.description: When Venti picks up an Elemental Orb or Particle, he receives a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.

constellations.name: Concerto dal Cielo
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Skyward Sonnet by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Storm of Defiance
constellations.description:
Targets who take DMG from Wind's Grand Ode have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.

outfits.name: Breezy Ode
outfits.description: Venti's outfit. The clothes of a carefree bard.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: *Yawn* That was a refreshing sleep. Ah, Traveler, we meet again! What? You don't remember me? Ahaha, well, allow me to join you on your quest once again. I must see to it that the bards of the world tell the Traveler's tales!

voices.title: Chat: Playing the Lyre
voices.text: Sure, I'll play you another tune, but it'll cost you an apple.

voices.title: Chat: Apple Cider
voices.text: Right now I wish I was sitting at the top of a tree, looking out over a meadow, cider in hand...

voices.title: Chat: Ballads
voices.text: Come on Traveler, let's go! The world is full of lost ballads just waiting to be rediscovered.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Let's go jumping in puddles and see who can make the biggest splash!

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: It's stopped raining already? A shame, I wanted to play some more.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Let's wait till the snow gets heavier and have a snowball fight!

voices.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voices.text: The wind has returned! Quick, let's go gliding!

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Morning! Ah... what's in store for today?

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: My tummy is rumbling, but I can't get caught pilfering food from the Dawn Winery again... Oh, it's you! Where are you heading? May I join?

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Hmm, I'm still not sleepy. Fancy an evening stroll?

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Off to the land of nod? Haha, farewell, my friend!

voices.title: About Venti
voices.text: Practice? Me? There's no need — I already know every song in Teyvat!

voices.title: About Us: New Songs
voices.text: I have decided to write a song about you! What are you giving me that look for? Can't afford it? Don't be preposterous, the price for you, my friend, is precisely zero Mora! Although... one thing you could do is tell me a few more of your stories!

voices.title: About Us: Heroes
voices.text: #Haha, once the {M#hero}{F#heroine} in the song has actually rescued the {M#princess}{F#prince}, I will ensure this song spreads to every corner of the continent!

voices.title: About Us: Apostles
voices.text: Ahh... an evening breeze really sets the mood for becoming my disciple, don't you think? We can do it right now... you just need to make me a small offering...

voices.title: About Us: Requests
voices.text: What's that? You think I should try harder to be a good Anemo Archon? Well, you could be a better devotee too... you could be more pious, more passionate, or... um...

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: Hmm? You want to know about my Vision? Oh, go on then, take a look for yourself. I can make you a matching one if you like! Hehehe.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Olah! Haha, that's how the Hilichurls say "hello." Why, I learned it to aid with my songwriting, of course! Vast knowledge makes for a richer composition... That said, I haven't actually written any songs in Hilichurlian so far...

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: Traveler, have you ever seen a Cecilia? It's a magnificent white wildflower that only grows on the most remote mountains and clifftops. To me, at least, it is the most beautiful flower in all of Teyvat.

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: Acting Grand Master Jean... Well, what do you think of her? Yes, I couldn't agree more: conscientious, courageous... kind and considerate too. Reminds me of another good friend...

voices.title: About Diluc
voices.text: I'm not surprised you want to befriend Master Diluc. Just think of all the vintage wine he must have stored away... Mwuhahaha... Huh? He doesn't let you sample it? Not even the slightest drop? Huh... Well, I guess you can still appreciate the aroma. That's still better than no wine at all, right? No?

voices.title: About Barbara
voices.text: The darling Deaconess with the sweet singing voice — do you know her? You do? Idol, huh? Meet and greets? Concerts? Wow... That's the power of music for you...

voices.title: About Razor
voices.text: Ah yes, the white-haired fellow from Wolvendom? Raised by wolves? Really? ... No wonder his scent is so familiar...

voices.title: About Mona
voices.text: Oh, that astrologer? How should I put it? Fortune-telling and my singing are the same: Both lead to you being so poor you can't even cough up the money for a drink! ...You think that astrology is a cultural tradition, so at least still has some value? Hmph, so rude. In that case, so too is singing, so it still has its value too!

voices.title: About Diona
voices.text: There's a special drink known far and wide at Cat's Tail. But it ah... ahh... ACHOO! *sniffs* How about you go and fetch one for me? I'll be truly thankful, I promise.

voices.title: About Albedo
voices.text: How do you explain white chalk in black soil, or the earth's dense crust amidst the emptiness of space? Same reason the purest soil gave birth to human life... It's an ancient power with unmistakable properties. Trying to harness it is dangerous indeed, I can't imagine what would happen if someone lost control of it in the city... Ah, never mind! What goes on within Mondstadt's walls is up to Mondstadt's people to deal with!

voices.title: About Morax
voices.text: Have you seen that gentleman around? Huh? He's just a normal man by the name of Zhongli now? That must be quite the change for that old block-head. Come with me to see him, will you? I have a vintage I dug up from Windrise that I can take as a condolence gift. Oh, ahh... did he still seem strong when you saw him? How strong? Am I likely to get blown away?

voices.title: About Eula
voices.text: Eula has good taste when it comes to beverages of the alcoholic variety. Come summer or winter, she always likes them ice-cold. That's rare among Mondstadters these days! She and I would make great drinking buddies. Huh? My songs about the Lawrence Clan... She's heard them already? Eh, no harm done. Maybe she and I can do a duet sometime!

voices.title: About Baal
voices.text: So, I hear you defeated the mighty Raiden Shogun? Ah, I recall the days when she was a kagemusha, seeking to perfect her martial prowess. Hehe, she now no doubt employs a wide range of reasoning to get you to train with her. Oh but yes, come close and I shall let you in on her weakness — desserts!

voices.title: About Buer
voices.text: The first thing you think of when you hear "Dendro Archon" is her power over dreams. Her dreams are akin to my ballads: full of emotion and imagination. It goes without saying that we get along really well.

voices.title: About Furina
voices.text: A bard must be versed in both music and song, but a stage performer requires far more skills than just these... Hey, don't you think we should invite her over to put on a show at the next Windblume Festival? ...Huh? You want me to talk about how she saved Fontaine? Well, I mean, she's such a talented artiste, it's no wonder. I wouldn't be surprised even if she'd saved the entire world.

voices.title: About Haborym
voices.text: This world sure is cruel, forcing generation upon generation of human heroes to become cannon fodder in the fight against darkness. But, under Mavuika's leadership, they achieved a truly god-like feat... Hehe, starting with "her," I suppose the Natlanese have always been like that. Ah, right! I heard Mavuika likes to drink! Are you thinking what I'm thinking...?

voices.title: About Dahlia
voices.text: O, Traveler, do you seek to hear the voice of the wind and know its guidance? Then I say to you... chatting to the deacon is your best bet. Haha, I'm kidding — come chat with me over a drink any time you want! The reason I usually get Dahlia to be my intermediary is because... well, I imagine you can probably guess why. He loves listening to the blustering of the wind, but crucially he has his own compass, too.

voices.title: About Durin
voices.text: Another one of Madame Mage's children here in Mondstadt, what fun! My new little friend looked like he wanted to play with a certain older, bigger friend of mine — so I arranged a little introduction, and voila! It turns out my big friend was the more excited of the two! Why, you should've seen him jumping for joy, patting his belly, and dancing in circles. Oh dear, did he hear what I just said? Quick, quick, let's take cover behind that tree!

voices.title: More About Venti: I
voices.text: Perfect timing, Traveler! I was about to ask you — what is your greatest wish?

voices.title: More About Venti: II
voices.text: There's never a dull moment traveling with you! The only minor inconvenience is that pesky little pixie thing that follows you everywhere... She never stops eating — I can't begin to imagine how much you spend on food!

voices.title: More About Venti: III
voices.text: The Pyro Archon is a wayward, warmongering wretch, and the Geo Archon is a brutish, blundering buffoon! How do I know? Because, this is written in the epic poems of days gone by!

voices.title: More About Venti: IV
voices.text: Celestia... I'm not sure even I could fly that far. In any case, the water there tastes foul, and the fruit is bland. You know what that means? No cider! Haha, in that case, I wouldn't go there even if I was invited.

voices.title: More About Venti: V
voices.text: My greatest wish? It has always been to roam free and experience the whole world. Now, I would add that wherever I go, it simply must be with you! Each day with you is an adventure, and where adventurers go, storytellers must follow!

voices.title: Venti's Hobbies
voices.text: I like to drink! And I like the wind! If only there were such a thing as wind-brewed cider...

voices.title: Venti's Troubles
voices.text: I'm actually highly allergic to cats. I start sneezing as soon as they enter the vicinity, and... Aah... Aa-choo! Ugh, apparently I can't even THINK about cats without sneezing. Do you think there is a cure for this monstrous affliction?

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: Here, have an apple. I just picked it. Look how ripe and juicy it is... *munching* ... Truly the fruit of the gods.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: Hmm, what's that tasty morsel you've got there...? Eww! A melted cheese pancake? A smelly, sticky, slimy, disgusting mess!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Ahh, quite delightful! So... could I get the same again tomorrow? ...And maybe the day after that?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Oof, I'm so full... I'll have to pass on the post-meal fruits this time...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: I can't believe it, but I don't think I can stomach this... Oh boy... What a predicament.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Someone once told me you're supposed to eat a cake on your birthday... Tada! Here's your birthday cake — it's apple-flavored! And here's a spoon. The cake didn't rise properly in the oven... That's why it looks more akin to an apple pie... Ugh, baking is really quite complicated!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Whoa! What was that?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Good work. Shall we repose for a moment with a tune? Shall it be a capriccio or a serenade?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Come, sit with me. I've written a new poem. I call it "Wind of the Traveler."

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: Hmm... Though I've long since viewed this scenery a great many times, there is something different about seeing it again with you. Surely you're not still concealing some other wondrous abilities? Hmm, even if you were, it would simply further prove that my intuition is correct.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Yoo-Hoo!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Here we go!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Brace yourselves!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: Let's play!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Think you can get away?

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Time for takeoff!

voices.title: Sprint Start: I
voices.text: Wouldn't gliding be faster?

voices.title: Deploying Wind Glider: I
voices.text: Yahoo!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: *clears throat* Have you heard The Ballad of the Treasure Chest?

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Thank Barbatos! Wait a minute...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: What a find! I wonder how many bottles this'll be worth...

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: Ugh, I'm not in the mood for this!

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Oh, dear!

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: That was uncalled for.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Let me try!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Don't give up!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Let me sleep a while...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Oh no, my lyre is broken...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Ah... Ugh...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ah!

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: How rude!

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Give me a moment to compose myself.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Didn't keep you waiting, did I?

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Ready for a rehearsal?
